messages:
elaine: installed redwoodctl via the new macOS dmg; `redwoodctl login --profile dev` completes but `redwoodctl local serve` errors with "profile mapping missing".
mohit: you upgraded from brew or previous binary? what version?
elaine: I had 0.9.9 from build last month; installed dmg 0.10.2 today. config shows profiles with ids, not names.
installer-bot: [info] dmg postinstall migration script skipped due to checksum mismatch
trent: looks like migration didn't run. quick check: `cat ~/.redwoodctl/config.json` — are profiles stored under a top-level map keyed by id?
elaine: yes. `redwoodctl profiles list` prints names but commands that accept `--profile staging` fail. using id works.
mohit: workaround: `redwoodctl profiles rename --id <id> --display staging` then commands accept the name. filing ISSUE-505 to make CLI resolve by id or display_name.
trent: also the dmg left config file owned by root so launchd couldn't read it — chown fixed it. we'll update installer to set correct ownership and run migration unconditionally.
elaine: noted, thanks — leaving the id workaround in my notes.
